preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is within the specified range.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All vertices in the edges are within the range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: No edge connects a vertex to itself.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly two pairs of vertices.
Each pair contains exactly two vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in output_pairs)
postconditions.description: All vertices in the output pairs are within the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all(x != y for x, y in output_pairs)
postconditions.description: No pair contains the same vertex twice.

postconditions.expression: all(x1 != x2 and x1 != y2 and y1 != x2 and y1 != y2 for (x1, y1), (x2, y2) in [(output_pairs[0], output_pairs[1])])
postconditions.description: All four vertices in the output pairs are distinct.

postconditions.expression: not any(v in path_x1_y1 for v in path_x2_y2) and not any(v in path_x2_y2 for v in path_x1_y1)
postconditions.description: Neither path from x1 to y1 nor from x2 to y2 contains any vertex from the other path.
The paths from x1 to y1 and from x2 to y2 have at least two common vertices.
The total length of the two paths is the sum of their individual lengths.
